summary: How to stake the bean rows so the vines have something to climb before midsummer.

# Staking the bean rows

Each bean row needs a stake every metre and a length of string pulled tight
between the tops, set up before the seedlings reach knee height. Hazel poles
from the hedge cutting work well and cost nothing. Pushing each pole thirty
centimetres into the soil keeps the row standing through a summer storm, and
tying the string loosely enough to slide leaves room for the vines to thicken.
